scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text:
It...
Can't be...
You've been reborn, haven't you?

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: I see you're retreading the path of the Swordman! Once you've gotten used to brandishing a sword, you can never go back!!

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: Hmm? Ah, you must first master the Basic Skills before you are ready to become a Swordman.

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: Come back to me when you have finished learning the Basic Novice Skills.

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: Excellent! Let me promote you to a Swordman right away!

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: Hmm... You look like a well-experienced Swordman. Still, I'm sure that you must train to improve your skills and gain strength!

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text:
Hm...?
You're a reborn
warrior, aren't you?

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text:
Hmmm...
It seems that being
a Swordman is not part
of your destiny. I'm sorry,
but it seems there is nothing
I can do for you.

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text:
Welcome to the
Swordman Association!

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text:
So...
What business
brings you to us?
Job Change
About Swordman.
About the Job requirements.
Cancel.

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: Job change? Muhahaha! But you're already a Swordman! Be proud and be strong!

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: Haha! Oh boy. I'm flattered, but you already have another job! Still, I can't blame you...

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: So you wish to become a proud Swordman? By all means, please sign up!
Sign up.
Cancel.

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: Ah, yes. Your application will be reviewed as soon as possible.

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: If you have already met the requirements, you can take an interview right now. Would you like to?
Yes.
No.

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text:
Good, good.
Now, let's see...

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: Alright then. Feel free to come back whenever you are ready. All you have to do now is meet our requirements. Good luck to you.

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: Hm? Alright, come back whenever you change your mind. The world can always use another Swordman!

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: Hm, you still haven't learned all of the Basic Skills. You need to do that before you can become a Swordman.

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: Hm, you've learned all of the Basic Skills but didn't take the test yet. You must first pass the exam before you can change your job to Swordman.

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: Hahaha! Congratulations! Now you are fully qualified to be a real Swordman! I will transform you right away!

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text:
[Swordman]
So you wish to know more about the mighty Swordman job? Well, then...

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: Check the requirements for job change again, and come back when you are ready.

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: Enter the room to my right so that you can take the test. You'll need to speak to my right so you can enter the examination area.

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: Once again, congratulations. I expect that you will be a good representative of the Swordman Association.

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: So you wish to know more about the mighty Swordman job? Well, then...

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text:
Amongst the First Class jobs, the Swordman is the best melee fighter for three reasons.
There are 3 reasons why Swordy is the best to approch a fight!

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: First, Swordman has the benefit of additional HP. Second, Swordman generally have access to a wider selection fo weapons than the other First Class jobs.

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: And third, most of the Swordman skills are crushing physical attacks! In my opinion, being a Swordman is the best job ever!

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text:
Hmmm...
But there's no need to tell you the requirements. You've met them and already became a Swordman! Well, anyway...

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text:
Hmmm...
It's too late for you to become a Swordman. You already have another job. Still, there's no harm in telling you...

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: Hmmm...

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: First, you must learn all 9 of the Basic Skills. If you can't complete this requirement, you won't be able to change to any job.

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: Second, you must pass the Swordman Test. Inquire the Test Manager located in the waiting room of the Swordman Test.

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: If you can complete these 2 requirements, you can change to a Swordman anytime you want.

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text:
Ha ha ha!
Ah, youth!

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: Sorry guy, but I can only allow Novices to enter the Test Hall.

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: Who the hell are you?! Nobody, other than Novices, is permitted to come in here!

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: Stop! I can't let you in until you learn all of the Basic Skills. The Test Hall isn't for goofing off!

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: Hey. You need to talk to the Swordman in the center of the room, not me.

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: Stop! If you want to take the Swordman Test, you'll need to fill out an application first.

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: The Swordman in the center of the room can help you with that, got it?

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: I will tell you about the Test! Listen carefully, I won't repeat myself.

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: The purpose of this test is to confirm whether or not you are qualified to be a Swordman. As you know, a Swordman needs physical strength and spirit!

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: Without those, you won't be able to become a Swordman. Now, the conditions for completing this test are very simple.

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: You will travel through three courses and must reach the final checkpoint within ^FF000010 minutes^000000.

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: If you choose to 'Surrender,' or if you run out of time, you will not pass the test.

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: If you find that you are not strong enough to pass the test, head to the entrance of the course and talk to the checkpoint manager.

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: As you travel through the three courses, you may fall to a random, underground area. The course is designed so that you can still find your way back.

scripts.speaker: Swordman
scripts.text: However, be careful, as this will waste your time! Godspeed to you.

scripts.speaker: Test Hall Staff
scripts.text: Hm? How did you get inside? You're not supposed to be in here, so please leave now.

scripts.speaker: Test Hall Staff
scripts.text: Who are you?! This place is for the Swordman Test! You're not allowed to be in here! Leave now!

scripts.speaker: Test Hall Staff
scripts.text: So are you the one who wants to be a Swordman? Alright! You look reliable!

scripts.speaker: Test Hall Staff
scripts.text: Retesting? Try not to worry about it. It's good that you don't back down from a challenge! Here, take these and cheer up!

scripts.speaker: Test Hall Staff
scripts.text: Don't ever give up! Now retesting!

scripts.speaker: Test Hall Staff
scripts.text: Try to relax and do your best. This course isn't so difficult.

scripts.speaker: Mae
scripts.text:
I sencerely congratulate you for passing the test!
I already sent your test result to the Job Department. Please inquire at the Officer in Centre.Thank you.

scripts.speaker: Medic
scripts.text: This is the {0} check point! Cheer up!

scripts.speaker: Test Hall Staff
scripts.text: Do you surrender?
Yes.
No.

scripts.speaker: Test Hall Staff
scripts.text: Bravo! Go for it again!

scripts.speaker: Test Hall Staff
scripts.text: Applicant {0}. Do you surrender??
Yes.
No.
